## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

1. Explain how commodity money systems worked and their limitations
2. Describe what free banking is and how it operated historically
3. Analyze historical cases of free banking (Scotland, the US, and others)
4. Evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of decentralized banking
5. Understand why central banks emerged as a response to free banking systems
